policy.name: Tamil Nadu Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Policy 2021 (Annexure I incentive schemes), as operated per MSME Department Policy Note 2025-26
policy.order_no: G.O.(Ms) No.11, MSME Department, dated 16-02-2021 (number per TANSIDCO G.O. listing; order text not opened)

zones.BB: 254 industrially backward blocks (Annexure II) and all Industrial Estates promoted by Government / agencies (SIPCOT, TANSIDCO etc.)
zones.REST: Other blocks (non-backward, outside government industrial estates)

zone_lookup: MSME Policy 2021 Annexure II 'List of Backward Blocks in the State' (p.34-39). Agro-based & food processing small/medium units are treated as eligible in all 388 blocks. Thrust sectors: Annexure V (p.42).

schemes.name: Capital subsidy for micro manufacturing enterprises
schemes.clause: MSME Policy 2021 Annexure I item 4.1; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: 25% of plant & machinery value, max Rs 25 lakh, anywhere in TN. New units, and existing units undertaking substantial expansion/diversification. Ineligible activities: Annexure III. Claim within 1 year of commencement of production (DIC).

schemes.name: Additional capital subsidy for micro enterprises
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 4.2; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: Additional 10% on P&M, max Rs 5 lakh, on top of item 4.1. New units, and existing units undertaking substantial expansion/diversification. Ineligible activities: Annexure III. Claim within 1 year of commencement of production (DIC).

schemes.name: Capital subsidy for small and medium enterprises (backward blocks / industrial estates)
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 4.3; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: 25% of P&M, max Rs 150 lakh, paid in three instalments. Only in 254 backward blocks / government industrial estates, except agro-based & food processing units (all 388 blocks). New units, and existing units undertaking substantial expansion/diversification. Ineligible activities: Annexure III. Claim within 1 year of commencement of production (DIC).
conditions: Unit in one of the 254 backward blocks or a government industrial estate (agro/food: any block)

schemes.name: Special capital subsidy for thrust sector MSMEs
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 4.6; Annexure V (thrust sectors); Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: Thrust-sector units (Annexure V) anywhere in the State; 25% of P&M, max Rs 150 lakh in 3 instalments. Use instead of 4.1/4.3 (not cumulative, presumed).

schemes.name: Additional capital subsidy - women / SC / ST / differently-abled / transgender entrepreneurs
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 4.4.2; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: Top-up 5% of P&M, max Rs 5 lakh. Micro: anywhere; small/medium: backward blocks/industrial estates or agro/food anywhere.
conditions: Special-category entrepreneur; small/medium units only in backward blocks or estates

schemes.name: Additional capital subsidy for cleaner and environment-friendly technologies
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 4.4.3; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: 25% of P&M/equipment installed for cleaner technologies, max Rs 10 lakh. Same location rules as capital subsidy (small/medium in BB or agro/food).

schemes.name: Additional capital subsidy for scaling up
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 4.4.5; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.1
schemes.notes: Existing micro/small units graduating to a higher category via expansion/diversification: extra 5% of P&M, max Rs 25 lakh.
conditions: Existing micro/small unit moving up a size category through expansion

schemes.name: Additional special capital subsidy for EV component & charging infrastructure manufacturing
schemes.notes: 20% additional special capital subsidy, additional cap Rs 10 lakh, anywhere in TN. Not listed in Policy Note 2025-26 - confirm still operative.
conditions: Electric-vehicle related manufacturing; confirm the scheme is still operative

schemes.name: Back-ended interest subsidy - technology upgradation term loans
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 5.1; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.4
schemes.notes: 5% interest subsidy on term loans up to Rs 500 lakh for technology upgradation/modernisation, 5 years, TOTAL cap Rs 25 lakh per enterprise (not annual). Policy 2021 says all new/existing enterprises; Policy Note 2025-26 says MSEs. Claimed quarterly.
conditions: Term loan for technology upgradation or modernisation

schemes.name: Back-ended interest subsidy - CGTMSE term loans
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 5.2; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.4
schemes.notes: 5% on term loans up to Rs 200 lakh under CGTMSE, 5 years, TOTAL cap Rs 20 lakh per enterprise. Alternative to 5.1 ('or').

schemes.name: Quality Certification (Q-CERT) reimbursement
schemes.clause: Annexure I item 10.2; Policy Note 2025-26 para 2.3.6
schemes.notes: 100% of certification + consultancy charges (ISO 9001/14001, HACCP, ISO 22000, GHP/GMP, BIS, ZED etc.): cap Rs 2 lakh per enterprise for national certifications, Rs 10 lakh for international certifications. Renewal of international certs: 25% up to Rs 1 lakh. Excludes travel/hotel/surveillance.

other_benefits: Low Tension Power Tariff (LTPT) subsidy: 20% of power charges for Tariff IIIB LT micro manufacturing units for first 36 months (item 4.5; PN 2.3.3) - percentage of bill, not per unit.
Payroll subsidy: employer EPF contribution for 3 years, max Rs 24,000/employee/yr, if >20 employees (item 4.4.1).
Generator subsidy: 25% of generator cost (up to 320 KVA), max Rs 5 lakh, micro units on rural feeders (item 4.7).

Stamp duty: 100% exemption on mortgage/pledge documents for micro (6.3); 50% rebate on stamp duty & registration in TANSIDCO/govt/private estates (7.5); 50% reimbursement on land purchase in backward blocks for MSEs (7.6).
PEACE energy audit: 75% of audit cost up to Rs 1 lakh; 50% of implementation up to Rs 10 lakh (10.1).
Patent: 75% of filing cost up to Rs 3 lakh per patent; trademark/GI 50% up to Rs 25,000 (3.1-3.2).
SME IPO: 20% of expenses up to Rs 5 lakh (item 2).
NEEDS (first-generation entrepreneurs): 25% of project cost up to Rs 50 lakh (policy) + 3% interest subvention (6.2).
unverifiable: No SGST reimbursement and no electricity duty exemption for MSMEs in the MSME Policy 2021 (those exist only under TN Industrial Policy for large projects).
G.O.(Ms) No.11 dt 16-02-2021 not opened (tn.gov.in / tansidco.tn.gov.in hosts unreachable); policy PDF and Policy Note 2025-26 read from Guidance Tamil Nadu (state investment agency) storage.

Governor's address (June 2026) and revised Budget 2026-27 (Aug 2026) say a new industrial policy will be unveiled; not released as of 17-Oct-2026 per available sources - re-check for a replacement MSME policy.
MSME Policy 2021 has no end date ('valid from the date of notification').
